description: Unit tests for the Toast component and ToastService in a Blazor web application, verifying toast display, hiding functionality, and event handling.

classes.name: ToastTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for verifying the behavior of Toast component and ToastService.

methods.name: ToastComponent_Shows_Info_SetsCssAndText
methods.description: Tests that the toast component properly displays an info toast with correct styling and text.

methods.name: ToastComponent_Shows_Success_Warning_Error
methods.description: Tests display of success, warning, and error toasts with appropriate styling and icons.

methods.name: ToastComponent_HideToast_InvokedViaService_PrivateMethod
methods.description: Simulates hiding the toast via reflection to test auto-dismiss functionality.

methods.name: ToastService_OnShow_StartsTimer_And_OnHide_Fires
methods.description: Verifies that the toast service triggers events and manages the internal timer correctly.
